goodToKnow: Das Ozon is ozone. In the stratosphere, die Ozonschicht protects us from UV radiation; the Ozonloch, caused by FCKW (CFCs), led to the 1987 Montreal Protocol, and the layer is slowly recovering. Near the ground, Ozon forms in summer heat from exhaust gases and irritates the lungs, so authorities issue Ozonwarnungen. It comes from Greek ozein (to smell). Stressed on the second syllable. It has no plural.
